1. Split the channel with the 2-D discrete wavelet transform into an approximation and J levels of details.
2. Estimate the noise sigma from the diagonal details of the finest level, unless it is set.
3. In every detail subband, compute the mean of the squared coefficients in each window, for each window size.
4. Subtract sigma squared, clip at 0, and keep the smallest estimate when there are several windows.
5. Multiply each coefficient by its Wiener gain.
6. Rebuild the channel with the inverse transform.
